notes: Paths in required are exact paths relative to the .app, including each extension; a file in another bundle does not satisfy a loader.
Forbidden patterns match every relative suffix, including flattened resource basenames inside extensions. Classified non-Release source basenames are forbidden too.
sample_roots must have every file classified. Update this inventory when adding samples; unused files are retained in source and excluded from Release.
Xcode folder-synchronized resources are flattened. Moving prices-9.json to Resources preserves its basename lookup for TourData and Debug samples.
Aresium engine includes the shop list in aresium-engine.js (scripts/aresium-engine.sh); there is no separately loaded shop JSON.

English literals fall back to their keys: Xcode emits no en .strings for tables with no translated English units. English plural .stringsdict files and explicit English translations are required where emitted.
Release exclusions include both direct-child and recursive patterns: Aresium PhoneSample fixtures are nested under Preview Content.
